parameters.help_en:
The original SQL statement corresponding to the API, which specifies the SQL style for data development.

For example, `select count(*) as deviceCount from ${system.device} where status = 1`. In this example, `${system.device}` is the device table of IoT Platform. For more information, see the table description in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120902.html
parameters.help_zh:
API对应的原始SQL，指定数据开发的SQL样式。

例如`select count(*) as deviceCount from ${system.device} where status = 1`。其中，`${system.device}`是平台系统的设备表，具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120902.html中的表说明

parameters.example: SELECT COUNT(iot_id) AS deviceCount FROM ${system.device} WHERE status=${status}
parameters.help_en:
The template SQL statement of the service, which is the templatized version of the original SQL statement.

For example, `select count(*) as deviceCount from ${system.device} where status = ${status}`. In this example, `${status}` is a templatized parameter. You can set template parameters to dynamic values
parameters.help_zh:

The API resource identifier, which is the globally unique identifier of the API.

`/device/getDeviceCountByStatus` is the value of the ApiPath request parameter, which is the custom part of the API calling address
